The exact SQL of lcsh-db-builder docs/SCHEMA_QUERIES.md v2 (sha256 of that file below), per query, with placeholders (:authorities) and <authority order> kept verbatim. sql.js must reproduce each text byte for byte before substitution. The coder must not edit this file.

Q1.sql:
SELECT id, uri, authority, label, label_normalized, deprecated, marc_key, scope_note
FROM auth
WHERE label_normalized = ?1
  AND authority IN (:authorities)
ORDER BY deprecated ASC, <authority order>, uri ASC
LIMIT 20;

Q2.sql:
SELECT a.id, a.uri, a.authority, a.label, a.label_normalized, a.deprecated, a.marc_key, a.scope_note
FROM auth a
WHERE a.id IN (SELECT l.auth_id FROM alt_label l WHERE l.label_normalized = ?1)
  AND a.authority IN (:authorities)
ORDER BY a.deprecated ASC, <authority order>, a.uri ASC
LIMIT 20;

Q3a.sql:
-- Q3a preferred
SELECT a.id, a.uri, a.authority, a.label, a.label_normalized, a.deprecated, a.marc_key, a.scope_note,
       bm25(auth_fts) AS score
FROM auth_fts JOIN auth a ON a.id = auth_fts.rowid
WHERE auth_fts MATCH ?1
  AND a.authority IN (:authorities)
ORDER BY score ASC, a.deprecated ASC, a.uri ASC
LIMIT 30;

Q3b.sql:
-- Q3b variants (bm25 cannot be used inside an aggregate: score in a subquery first; this form tested on 468k LCSH records 2026-09-27: no table scans, <= 5.5 ms)
SELECT a.id, a.uri, a.authority, a.label, a.label_normalized, a.deprecated, a.marc_key, a.scope_note,
       min(s.score) AS score
FROM (SELECT l2.id AS lid, bm25(alt_label_fts) AS score
      FROM alt_label_fts
      JOIN alt_label l2 ON l2.id = alt_label_fts.rowid
      JOIN auth a2 ON a2.id = l2.auth_id
      WHERE alt_label_fts MATCH ?1
      ORDER BY score, a2.authority, a2.uri, l2.label, l2.lang, l2.kind
      LIMIT 500) s
JOIN alt_label l ON l.id = s.lid
JOIN auth a ON a.id = l.auth_id
WHERE a.authority IN (:authorities)
GROUP BY a.id
ORDER BY score ASC, a.deprecated ASC, a.uri ASC
LIMIT 30;

Q4.sql:
SELECT h.target_authority, h.target_uri,
       t.id, t.uri, t.authority, t.label, t.label_normalized, t.deprecated, t.marc_key, t.scope_note
FROM hierarchy h
LEFT JOIN auth t ON t.uri = h.target_uri AND t.authority = h.target_authority
WHERE h.auth_id = ?1 AND h.rel = 'use'
ORDER BY h.target_authority, h.target_uri;

Q5.sql:
SELECT h.rel, h.target_authority, h.target_uri, t.label
FROM hierarchy h
LEFT JOIN auth t ON t.uri = h.target_uri AND t.authority = h.target_authority
WHERE h.auth_id = ?1 AND h.rel IN ('broader','narrower','related','see_also')
ORDER BY h.rel, t.label, h.target_uri
LIMIT 200;
